symptom: PC1 cannot reach Server1 in VLAN 30

GigabitEthernet0/0.10 is up, line protocol is up
GigabitEthernet0/0.30 is administratively down, line protocol is down

show ip interface brief
configure terminal
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30
no shutdown

symptom: PC in VLAN 20 cannot reach its gateway

interface fa0/5
switchport access vlan 20
